assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The 24.5-hectare Qinghuayuan core demonstrator and its FAR, GFA, green-space and public-open-space targets are participant-defined design parameters, not official boundaries or approved controls.
assumptions.impact: All core-zone indicators must be recalculated and adjusted after official red lines, ownership, building survey and statutory planning conditions are obtained.

assumptions.statement: The structural condition of the former Qinghuayuan Station is assumed to permit conservation and adaptive reuse.
assumptions.impact: A professional heritage and structural survey is required before deciding the retain-renovate-demolish treatment.

assumptions.statement: The proposed low-speed Robobus loop is assumed to be capable of sharing or reallocating existing municipal road right-of-way.
assumptions.impact: Traffic engineering, operating authorization and road-safety review are prerequisites for implementation.

assumptions.statement: The five inclusion personas and three-layer non-digital fail-safe describe service requirements; facility quantities, opening hours, subsidies and the proposed 48-hour review target remain subject to co-design, applicable law and operating budgets.
assumptions.impact: The proposal establishes an inclusion baseline without claiming that every service is already funded, staffed or approved.

assumptions.statement: Surface or shallow modular micro-corridors and wireless edge stations are reversible alternatives to continuous underground construction; no cost-saving percentage is treated as verified without a bill-of-quantities and life-cycle comparison.
assumptions.impact: Engineering selection must follow survey, rail and heritage protection, municipal, spectrum, cybersecurity, fire-safety and cost review.

assumptions.statement: Machine-readable tables confirm the alignment of selected numbers, identifiers and caveats, but substantive bilingual equivalence still requires human review by language and planning professionals.
assumptions.impact: Formal publication must not rely on automated string matching alone.
